body: We present SmartSalesBench, the first multi-turn conversational benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate large language model (LLM) sales agents against psychologically grounded, resistant buyer personas. Existing task-oriented dialogue benchmarks assume cooperative users and measure task completion; SmartSalesBench inverts this assumption, placing agents against personas programmed to resist and challenge across conversations of up to twenty turns. The benchmark includes five agent profiles, twelve buyer personas, fifteen smartphone products across six price tiers, and four controlled experiments with 3 iterations totaling 13,680 sessions. Both sales-agent and buyer persona generations are grounded through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We introduce nine evaluation metrics grouped into three tiers: primary outcome metrics (CR, BRS, RIR), secondary quality metrics (SMS, PFS, ETI), and exploratory metrics planned for future reporting (ITS, ARI, SPI). Our evaluation combines automated LLM-as-judge scoring with internal human assessment (n = 50, appa = 0.71, Pearson r = 0.81 with BRS).
summaryZh: SmartSalesBench：用于评估 LLM 销售代理的阻力感知多轮基准。我们推出了 SmartSalesBench，这是第一个多轮对话基准，明确设计用于根据心理基础、阻力买家角色来评估大语言模型 (LLM) 销售代理。现有的面向任务的对话基准假设用户合作并衡量任务完成情况； SmartSalesBench 颠倒了这一假设，将座席与被编程为在最多 20 轮对话中抵抗和挑战的人物角色放在一起。
